run_mfg_psro: run mean-field PSRO with configurable regret minimizer, best responder, and value estimator on MFG games
create_hedge_regret_minimizer: create a Hedge regret minimizer for mean-field PSRO with compression and value estimation options
compute_correlated_equilibrium_gap: compute CCE gap and optional CE gap for mean-field game policies and distributions
build_mf_psro_solver: build a MeanFieldPSRO solver with a regret minimizer and best responder for iterative PSRO
run_mfg_psro_cli: run mfg_psro CLI with game_name, regret_minimizer, best_responder, and n_iter flags
